_comment: Copy to google_oauth.json (gitignored) and fill in. Build with: flutter build apk --release --target-platform android-arm --dart-define-from-file=google_oauth.json
_ambient: OAuth client type 'TVs and Limited Input devices' — for the Google Photos Ambient API (device-code/QR).
_drive: OAuth client type 'Desktop app' — for Google Drive (drive.readonly, loopback consent on the Mac via tools/google_photo_consent.py).
